diff.title: Diff
diff.noSelection: Select a commit or file to see its diff
diff.noTextDiff: No text diff to show (binary, empty, or unchanged).
diff.lfsNote: This file is tracked by Git LFS — its binary content is stored outside the repository.

image.omittedNote: One side of this image is too large to load into the viewer, so neither is shown — a single side would look like the file had just been added or deleted.

diff.omittedNote: This file is too large to load whole, so syntax highlighting is limited to each hunk. The diff itself is complete.
diff.wholeRefusedNote: This file is too large to show in full, so the ordinary unified diff is shown instead. What you see is complete, just narrower — the setting still applies to other files.
